intent.problem: The real v0.5.46 publication created an immutable tag and Draft Release, then failed in the tagged Quick Install check because the workflow used test "$asset_id" =~ regex. Bash test does not implement =~, so the intended Draft asset validation was structurally unexecutable.
constraints: Keep v0.5.45 and v0.5.46 immutable tags and retained Draft Releases as failure evidence.
Advance exactly one patch beyond the highest reserved version, to v0.5.47.
Do not change the public v0.5.42 projection or weaken release gates.
Use focused local verification under the user-authorized temporary efficiency policy; retain governance gates and Hosted CI.
intent.rationale: The release workflow must prove its real Draft asset retrieval path before public publication; syntax-level validation prevents the same deterministic failure from consuming another semantic version.

verification.reason: Temporary user-authorized focused-verification exception; it does not waive governance gates or full Hosted CI.

rollbackNote: Revert only this corrective Work Item through its PR if required; preserve v0.5.45 and v0.5.46 provider evidence and do not mutate their tags or Draft Releases.
